sn55.6:2.3: dvīhaṃ tīhaṃ ṭhito kho so puriso addasa bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ

sn55.6:3.2: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma yena aññataraṃ rukkhamūlaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.

sn55.6:14.1: tasmā tiha thapatayo sambādho gharāvāso rajāpatho abbhokāso pabbajjā
sn55.6:14.2: alaṃ ca pana vo thapatayo appamādāyāti.
sn55.6:14.3: atthi kho no bhante etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro ceva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cāti.
sn55.6:14.4: katamo pana vo thapatayo etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro ceva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cāti.
sn55.6:15.1: idha mayaṃ bhante yadā rājā pasenadi kosalo uyyānabhūmiṃ niyyātukāmo hoti ye te rañño pasenadissa kosalassa nāgā oparuyhā te kappetvā yā tā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa pajāpatiyo piyā manāpā tā ekaṃ purato ekaṃ pacchato nisīdāpema.
sn55.6:15.2: tāsaṃ kho pana bhante bhaginīnaṃ evarūpo gandho hoti seyyathāpi nāma gandhakaraṇḍakassa tāva deva vivariyamānassa yathā taṃ rājakaññānaṃ gandhena vibhūsitānaṃ.
sn55.6:15.3: tāsaṃ kho pana bhante bhaginīnaṃ evarūpo kāyasamphasso hoti seyyathāpi nāma tūlapicuno vā kappāsapicuno vā yathā taṃ rājakaññānaṃ sukheṭhitānaṃ.
sn55.6:15.4: tasmiṃ kho pana bhante samaye nāgopi rakkhitabbo hoti tāpi bhaginiyo rakkhitabbā honti attāpi rakkhitabbo hoti.
sn55.6:15.5: na kho pana mayaṃ bhante abhijānāma tāsu bhaginīsu pāpakaṃ cittaṃ uppādetā.
sn55.6:15.6: ayaṃ kho no bhante etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro ceva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cāti.
sn55.6:16.1: tasmā tiha thapatayo sambādho gharāvāso rajāpatho abbhokāso pabbajjā
sn55.6:16.2: alaṃ ca pana vo thapatayo appamādāya.
sn55.6:16.3: catūhi kho thapatayo dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.6:17.2: idha thapatayo ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.6:17.3: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.6:17.6: vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇī vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato.
sn55.6:17.7: imehi kho thapatayo catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.6:18.1: tumhe kho thapatayo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatā
sn55.6:18.2: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.6:18.5: yaṃ kho pana kiñci kule deyyadhammaṃ sabbantaṃ appaṭivibhattaṃ sīlavantehi kalyāṇadhammehi.
sn55.6:18.7: kati viya te kosalesu manussā ye tumhākaṃ samasamā yadidaṃ
